## Enforcement (ARMED)

`coding-standards-lint.py` enforces the deterministic rules above as a
PostToolUse hook on Write/Edit: `set -euo pipefail` on new shell scripts,
and script naming. Interpretive rules (error handling, PEP 8 judgment) stay
prose - a hook cannot read them.

Bypass one file with `# coding-standards-lint-skip` plus a one-line reason.

Scope note: the shell rule applies to NEW files only. Measured on 400 tracked
files, the unnarrowed rule would have blocked edits to 36 of them, including
linear-worker.sh, kipi-dispatch.sh, converge.sh, slack-notify.sh and
repo-preflight.sh - the autonomous loop's own hot path. After narrowing:
0 of 400. Arming a gate that blocks the loop that arms gates is how a system
wedges itself, so the blast radius was measured before the switch, not after.
